The '''Bosthirda separatists''' were a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-based organization that tried to secede their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]; in truth they were only thralls of the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Xedrix]], who used them in his machinations. At last on [[3954 BBY]] they were discovered and annihilated by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]'s troops.<ref name="Revan" />
